Guidance

Medical repatriation companies in the UK

List of medical repatriation companies for British nationals who are seriously ill or injured abroad and need medical evacuation to the UK.

From:
Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
Published:
10 April 2018
Last updated:
26 August 2026 — See all updates

Contents

  1. List of companies
  2. Feedback

This list is provided for British nationals for information only. The Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) does not recommend or endorse any company as to their suitability or competence. It is your responsibility to contact the companies to confirm that they are affiliated with all appropriate regulatory bodies, and that you carry out your own enquiries and due diligence checks to ensure they are suitable for your particular requirements.

Some may offer their services voluntarily on a ‘pro bono’ basis – check first if they are able to offer this. Also check they provide translation services for the country the repatriation is from, if this is needed.

Read the disclaimer relating to this guidance.

If you use any of the organisations in this list, we would like to hear from you. While there is no obligation on your part to provide feedback, any information you can give us is helpful.
